CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  June 7, 2021

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tang, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia, Gardea

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Andrew Ho, Director; Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal
  Planner; Mario Arellano, Assistant Planner; Werner Abrego, Assistant
  Planner; Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Gardea

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  •  There were no Consent Agenda items.

E.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-20-05
  • 1416 Benito Avenue
  • Applicant: SLS Design
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit
  PD-20-05 to construct a 7,855 square foot, seven (7) residential unit
  apartment complex on a site of approximately 13,750 square feet
  located in the R-3 (Multiple Family Residential) zone, for a property
  located at 1416 Benito Avenue in the City of Alhambra. (This
  application is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.)
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 21-11, approving
  Planned Development Permit PD-20-05 subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.
  1
  06/07/2021
   •  Assistant Planner Mario Arellano provided the Staff presentation.
  •  Crystal Wong, Crystal Lui, and Vincent Tsoi, Applicants, were
  available to answer questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 1 with revised Conditions of Approval for
  PW5.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Tang, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tang, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

AGENDA
ITEM 2:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-20-34 AND TENTATIVE TRACT
  MAP TTM-20-02
  • 749-801 South Sierra Vista Avenue
  • Applicant: Kamen Lai
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit
  PD-20-34 and Tentative Tract Map TTM-20-02 to develop a two-story,
  18-unit, condominium complex on a site of approximately 27,020
  square feet located in the R-3 (Multiple Family Residential) zone.
  (This application is exempt from the California Environmental Quality
  Act.)
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 21-14, approving
  Planned Development Permit PD-20-34 and Tentative Tract Map
  TTM-20-02 subject to the Conditions of Approval.
  • Associate Planner Scott Quyle provided the Staff presentation.
  • Kamen Lai, Applicant, was available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 2.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tang, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

  2
  06/07/2021
 AGENDA
ITEM 3:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-21-22 AND REVISION TO
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CU-16-15
  • 1508 South Marengo Avenue
  • Applicant: TAG-2 Medical Investment Group LLC
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit
  PD-21-22 and Revision to Conditional Use Permit CU-16-15 for the
  construction of a new 2-story, 11,286 square foot, 34-bed skilled
  nursing facility addition to an existing skilled nursing facility located on
  a site of approximately 69,261 square feet (1.59 acres) located in the
  R-3 (High Density Residential) zone. An addendum to the previously
  adopted Mitigated Negative Declaration for this project has been
  prepared.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 21-15, approving the
  CEQA Addendum, Planned Development Permit PD-21-22, and
  Revision to Conditional Use Permit CU-16-15 subject to the
  Conditions of Approval.
  • Principal Planner Paul Lam provided the Staff presentation.
  • Bruce Macpherson and Steve St. Clair, Applicants, provided the
  Applicant presentation and were available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue Agenda Item 3 to a date uncertain, with the item to
  return with the following additional details: 1.) Revised site plan showing
  contextual positioning of the building; 2.) Site plan with landscaping
  details; 3.) Further environmental analysis regarding traffic; 4.) VMT
  analysis; 5.) Discussion on parking; and 6.) Mitigation Monitoring and
  Reporting Program compliance details.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Vice President Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tang, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

•  Commissioner Gardea recused himself from Agenda Item 4.

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-20-29, CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT CUP-20-06 AND TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP TP 83396
  • 2970-2990 West Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Artem Golestian
  • Request: This is an application for Planned Development Permit PD-
  20-29, Conditional Use Permit CUP-20-06 and Tentative Parcel Map
  3
  06/07/2021
   TP 83396 to merge 2 lots into 1 and to construct a new 2,993 square
  foot fully automated car wash on a site of approximately 18,199 square
  feet located at 2970-2990 West Valley Boulevard in the VSP (Valley
  Boulevard Corridor Specific Plan) zone in the City of Alhambra. (This
  item is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.)
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 21-13, approving
  Planned Development Permit PD-20-29, Conditional Use Permit CUP-
  20-06, and Tentative Parcel Map TP 83396 subject to the Conditions
  of Approval.
  •  Assistant Planner Mario Arellano provided the Staff presentation.
  •  Artem Golestian, Applicant, was available to answer questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Pablo Ortega
  2.) Marisol Romero-Ortega
  3.) David Nguyen
  4.) Antonio Gardea
  5.) Ricky Choi

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue Agenda Item 4 to the June 21, 2021, Planning
  Commission regular meeting.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-1-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tang, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia
  Noes:  None
  Recused: Gardea
  Absent: None

F.  DIRECTOR’S REPORT

  •  There was no Director’s Report.

G.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no public comments.

H.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS:

  •  Commissioner Tang expressed a thank you to the residents and Planning
  Commissioners that participated. It’s exciting to see so much participation and he
  hopes to see them more often.

  4
  06/07/2021
 I.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 10:56 P.M. to Monday,
  June 21, 2021, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Chris Olson
  President
